abstract.t: This document proposes two complementary optimizations for the BGP Monitoring Protocol (BMP) Route Monitoring message to significantly reduce network overhead and improve monitoring efficiency. The first optimization defines an aggregated BMP Route Monitoring message based on the Multi-Peer Header mechanism, which compresses multiple BMP Route Monitoring messages into a single aggregated message by leveraging BGP group packaging technology. The second optimization introduces a Common Update TLV that eliminates redundant transmission of routes unchanged by inbound or outbound policies across different RIB views. These optimizations work together to reduce the number of reported BMP messages, decrease bandwidth consumption, and improve processing efficiency for both monitored routers and monitoring stations.
